title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 42
description: Ten questions on Genesis 42: Joseph's brothers come to Egypt to buy grain and meet the governor of the land.

questions.text: How many of Joseph's brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:3 says Joseph's ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

questions.text: Which brother did Jacob not send to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Jacob didn't send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, because he said, "Lest perhaps harm happen to him."

questions.text: What did Joseph's brothers do when they came before him?
questions.explanation: Joseph's brothers came and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.

answers.text: They asked him his name and where he was from
They offered him a present of balm and honey
They wept and embraced him one by one
They bowed down with their faces to the earth

questions.text: What did Joseph accuse his brothers of being?
questions.explanation: Joseph remembered his dreams and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land."

questions.text: How long did Joseph keep all his brothers in custody together?
questions.explanation: Joseph put them all together into custody for three days.

questions.text: What did the brothers say to one another about Joseph's distress?
questions.explanation: They said, "We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn't listen."

answers.text: "We are certainly guilty concerning our brother"

questions.text: Why didn't the brothers know that Joseph understood what they said?
questions.explanation: They didn't know Joseph understood them, because there was an interpreter between them.

answers.text: There was an interpreter between them

questions.text: Which brother did Joseph take and bind before their eyes?
questions.explanation: Joseph took Simeon from among them and bound him before their eyes.

questions.text: What did one brother find in the mouth of his sack at the lodging place?
questions.explanation: When one of them opened his sack to feed his donkey, he saw his money in the mouth of his sack.

questions.text: What did Reuben offer his father if he did not bring Benjamin back?
questions.explanation: Reuben said to his father, "Kill my two sons, if I don't bring him to you."

answers.text: That his two sons could be killed
That he would give up his inheritance
That he himself would become a slave
That he would pay twenty pieces of silver
